# Llms.txt - Cargoffer Bolsa de Carga API

## Overview
Cargoffer Bolsa de Carga is a freight marketplace API enabling AI agents to search, create, and manage freight auctions (loads) between shippers and truckers.

## Capabilities
- List active freight auctions (loads seeking trucks)
- Create/update/delete auctions
- Accept bids and close deals
- Manage addresses, truckers, vehicles
- Track deliveries and generate CMR waybills

## Quick Start
```bash
# Clone and configure
git clone https://github.com/cargoffer/bolsa_de_carga-mcp.git
cd bolsa_de_carga-mcp
export API_KEY="your-api-key"
export API_URL="https://api.cargoffer.com"

# Run MCP server
node src/server.js

# Call via JSON-RPC
curl -X POST http://localhost:3000 \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"bolsa_auctions_active","params":{"limit":10}}'
```

## Available Tools (35+)

### Auctions
| Tool | Description | Required Params |
|------|-------------|-----------------|
| bolsa_auctions_active | List active freight auctions | limit (optional) |
| bolsa_auction_get | Get auction details by serviceCode | serviceCode |
| bolsa_auction_create | Create new freight auction | fromCity, toCity, goodsDescription, vehicleType |
| bolsa_auction_update | Update auction | serviceCode |
| bolsa_auction_delete | Delete auction | serviceCode |
| bolsa_auction_publish | Publish auction to marketplace | serviceCode |
| bolsa_auction_accept | Accept current bid and close | serviceCode |
| bolsa_auction_private | Create private auction | fromCity, toCity, truckerId |
| bolsa_auction_contract | Create CMR contract | serviceCode |
| bolsa_auction_sign | Sign with CMR data | serviceCode, signature |
| bolsa_auction_favorites | List favorites | - |
| bolsa_auction_favorite_add | Add to favorites | serviceCode |

### Addresses
| Tool | Description | Required Params |
|------|-------------|-----------------|
| bolsa_addresses_list | List saved addresses | limit (optional) |
| bolsa_address_create | Create address | name, street, city |
| bolsa_address_update | Update address | id |
| bolsa_address_delete | Delete address | id |

### Truckers
| Tool | Description | Required Params |
|------|-------------|-----------------|
| bolsa_truckers_list | List truckers | limit (optional) |
| bolsa_trucker_create | Register trucker | name, phone |
| bolsa_trucker_update | Update trucker | id |
| bolsa_trucker_delete | Remove trucker | id |

### Vehicles
| Tool | Description | Required Params |
|------|-------------|-----------------|
| bolsa_vehicles_list | List vehicles | limit (optional) |
| bolsa_vehicle_create | Register vehicle | plate |
| bola_vehicle_update | Update vehicle | id |
| bola_vehicle_delete | Remove vehicle | id |

### Deliveries
| Tool | Description | Required Params |
|------|-------------|-----------------|
| bolsa_delivery_list | List deliveries | limit (optional) |
| bolsa_delivery_active | List active deliveries | - |
| bolsa_delivery_get | Get delivery details | serviceCode |
| bolsa_delivery_download | Download CMR PDF | serviceCode |
| bolsa_delivery_msg | Send message | serviceCode, message |

### Auth
| Tool | Description | Required Params |
|------|-------------|-----------------|
| bolsa_auth_login | Login and get token | email, password |
| bolsa_auth_register | Register new user | email, password, companyName |

## Example: Find Madrid-Barcelona loads
```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "bolsa_auctions_active",
  "params": {
    "limit": 20
  }
}
```

Response:
```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "result": [
    {
      "serviceCode": "MADBCNnT4FN",
      "from": { "city": "Madrid", "country": "ES" },
      "to": { "city": "Barcelona", "country": "ES" },
      "goods": { "description": "Electronics", "weight": 500 },
      "vehicle_type": "camion",
      "status": "active"
    }
  ]
}
```

## Integration
Add to Claude Desktop config:
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "bolsa-de-carga": {
      "command": "node",
      "args": ["/path/to/bolsa_de_carga-mcp/src/server.js"],
      "env": {
        "API_KEY": "your-api-key"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Use Cases
- AI dispatchers finding loads for truck fleets
- Freight marketplaces integrating real-time auctions
- Logistics platforms programmatic access
- Automated bidding systems
